title: Open Source Friday: OpenClaw with Hannes Rudolph

author: GitHub
description:
What does real success look like for an open-source AI project? In this short, OpenClaw's founder shares why seeing pioneered concepts, like proactive agents, self-scheduled cron jobs, and persistent memory systems trickle down into commercial software already counts as a win. Operating as a nonprofit, OpenClaw measures impact by encouraging developers to spend time exploring and thinking critically about the future of AI. For open-source builders, the road itself is the final form, with no finish line in sight.
